metadata.title: अबूझमाड़ का सबसे बड़ा आदिवासी मेला | Tribal Mavli Mela of Naryanpur | Gond Tribe | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: The Mavli Mela, held in the Bastar region, is a renowned fair that commences on the Wednesday preceding Maha Shivratri. It holds significant cultural and social importance for the Madia and Muria tribal communities. Adivasis participate by bringing their deities to the fair, marked by rituals dedicated to these tribal gods during the first half of the opening day. This fair serves as a focal point for community gatherings, religious observances, and cultural exchange in the Narayanpur district of Chhattisgarh.
